card.name: Specs of aircraft, tanks and machines
card.fires_on: Spots inside technical spec text about military vehicles, jets and big machines, such as model numbers, currency signs, and spaces before figures. Often partway through a model name or number.

modes.label: Model numbers
modes.description: Digits or separators inside aircraft or tank designations.

modes.label: Cost and figures
modes.description: The dollar sign or space just before a spec figure in a data table.

modes.label: Descriptive modifiers
modes.description: Modifiers like -range or -plus attached to numbers or machine types.
